caseName: Standard Accident Insurance v. United States
caseNameFull: STANDARD ACCIDENT INSURANCE COMPANY AND ALBERT E. MCKENZIE AS TRUSTEES IN BANKRUPTCY OF THE GRAVES-QUINN CORPORATION v. United States

opinions.text:
Government contract; no breach of contract by sovereign acts of defendant. Defendant’s demurrer sustained.

*857Plaintiffs’ petition for writ of certiorari denied by the Supreme Court October 8, 1945.
